mode: Accept all recommendations; the updated recommendation where gate-a.md gives one. No exceptions named.
authorises: The shadow build (Phases 2, 3, 5, 6): computed and logged, shown to nobody. Not clinical use.
secondReviewerNote: D-NCD-17 four-eyes signing needs a second clinical reviewer before any clinical go-live; not required for the shadow build.
goLiveItems: The tenth review's answers (V01–V16) have not been independently re-read; see phase-1/review-rounds.md. One more independent read is required before anything leaves shadow.

D-DM-01.title: Default criteria set for Uganda
D-DM-01.decision: UCG 2023 as the default set (`ug_ucg_2023`, filled from UCG-DM-01..03), with WHO HEARTS-D 2020 shown alongside and every difference listed; operators as P0-25.

D-DM-02.title: Which symptoms let one glucose value diagnose
D-DM-02.decision: Uganda set: UCG's four classical symptoms. WHO set: WHO/ADA's three. Each set states its own.

D-DM-03.title: Random glucose of 11 or 11.1 in HIV care
D-DM-03.decision: Screen on UCG's risk factors at every site; a universal 24–28-week OGTT only at sites that choose it.

D-DM-04.title: A glucose meter for diagnosis and for control
D-DM-04.decision: Yes, as WHO allows: diagnose on a meter with symptoms or with a repeat on another day; never rule out on a meter value near a threshold; read a fasting or post-meal meter value against WHO's surrogates for control.

D-DM-05.title: Who is offered a test without symptoms
D-DM-05.decision: WHO's rule everywhere (40 or over and overweight). ADA's 'overweight with another risk factor' at sites with a laboratory. ADA's 'everyone from 35' off.

D-DM-06.title: What counts as 'tested and negative'
D-DM-06.decision: 'Full' only with a normal 2-hour OGTT. A normal fasting glucose or HbA1c alone is 'limited', with a re-test date.

D-DM-07.title: How near is 'near the threshold'
D-DM-07.decision: Within the fasting glucose's own within-person variation (REF-DM-VAL-FPG-CV) below the threshold.

D-DM-08.title: Time windows that are product settings
D-DM-08.decision: You set both. Until you do, the rules that depend on them stay dark (REF-DX-RESULT-AGE-GLUCOSE has no value on purpose).

D-DM-09.title: Order of the next-best test
D-DM-09.decision: As written in DM-ACT-TEST-01: symptomatic, a random glucose now; no symptoms with a laboratory, fasting plasma glucose, then an OGTT if it is 6.1 to 6.9; HbA1c only where no caveat holds; no laboratory, a fasting meter reading repeated on another day; pregnant, a 75 g OGTT; on steroids, after a meal.

D-DM-10.title: Suspecting type 1
D-DM-10.decision: Two of: under 35, BMI below 25, unexplained weight loss (and, in established diabetes, glucose above 20 at presentation). Same day when the diagnosis is new or the type is unclassified and the person is not on insulin; routine once a clinician has recorded the type.

D-DM-11.title: C-peptide thresholds
D-DM-11.decision: Not yet. Keep both criteria held out until a person has read the source figure (Holt 2021 Fig. 1; ADA 2026 Fig. 2.1), then restore them with the timing conditions.

D-DM-12.title: Testing in pregnancy
D-DM-12.decision: Yes, at 24 weeks or more, at sites that can run one (FIGO). Elsewhere it stays off and the meter referral rules apply.

D-DM-13.title: Exactly at the target
D-DM-13.decision: Uganda targets from UCG: fasting below 7.0, postprandial below 10.0, HbA1c below 7.0% (7.5% for the elderly, age from REF-DM-CTRL-OLDER-AGE until UCG's 'elderly' is defined). No inclusive edge is then needed.

D-DM-14.title: Eyes: how often, and who is referred
D-DM-14.decision: A lipid profile at diagnosis where the site can run one (UCG); the yearly prompt off where it cannot.

D-DM-15.title: Lipid testing at district sites
D-DM-15.decision: Off where the site has no lipid profile; on where it has. The statin prompt in type 2 diabetes at 40 or over does not depend on it.

D-DM-16.title: 'Kidney failure' as a hypoglycaemia risk
D-DM-16.decision: Treatment-review steps on as review prompts with no dose, following UCG's ladder (lifestyle, metformin, glimepiride, basal insulin).

D-DM-17.title: An ACR of exactly 30 mg/mmol
D-DM-17.decision: Severely increased (30 or more), as KDIGO's own figures and ADA have it.

D-DM-18.title: Loss of protective sensation
D-DM-18.decision: One (IWGDF): monofilament or vibration; light touch where neither tool exists.

D-DM-19.title: eGFR below 30
D-DM-19.decision: Same day from primary care (WHO HEARTS-D).

D-DM-20.title: Treatment suggestions in version 1
D-DM-20.decision: Tests, screening, referral, education, targets and safety flags: on. Treatment review steps: on as review prompts with no dose, once you have read them against UCG 2023 section 8.1.3; dark until then.

D-DM-21.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists for heart and kidney protection
D-DM-21.decision: Recognise glibenclamide and flag it in the pack's three situations; never propose it; name glimepiride (UCG) as the sulfonylurea when a step names one.

D-DM-22.title: Glibenclamide, and which sulfonylurea at which level
D-DM-22.decision: Recognise it (patients still take it), flag it at 60 or over, with reduced kidney function and where lows are a concern, and never propose it. Name the sulfonylurea per level of care only after the EMHSLU 2023 endocrine pages are read.

D-DM-23.title: Blood pressure threshold in diabetes
D-DM-23.decision: Below 130/80 (UCG 4.1.6, matching HEARTS-D); the 120/80 in 8.1.3 recorded as a conflict.

D-DM-24.title: A glucose of exactly 3.9 or 3.0
D-DM-24.decision: Show both: UCG 2023 as the national set, WHO 2013 alongside; refer on a meter as the pack recommends; P0-26 chooses the default.

D-DM-25.title: 'Above 7.8' in hospital
D-DM-25.decision: Add gt_ref to the vital atom.

D-DM-26.title: Insulin storage advice
D-DM-26.decision: Carry only the advice nobody contests (refrigerate unopened insulin, never freeze it, keep a vial in use out of the sun) and say nothing about clay pots until you have read both sources.

D-DM-27.title: Vaccines
D-DM-27.decision: No. Uganda's routine schedule has none for this group, and ADA's table is the US schedule.

D-DM-28.title: A meter reading in pregnancy
D-DM-28.decision: Refer on it: any reading of 11.1 or more, or a fasting reading of 7.0 or more, today; a fasting reading of 5.1 to 6.9, for a laboratory glucose. Diagnose gestational diabetes on plasma glucose only. Default: WHO 2013 (P0-26).

D-DM-29.title: A raised glucose during acute illness or at TB diagnosis
D-DM-29.decision: 16, by numeric age in the evaluation context, independent of the display band (P0-01).

D-DM-30.title: Which pregnancy facts are a restricted class
D-DM-30.decision: 'Could become pregnant' and previous gestational diabetes: restricted. Current pregnancy: not restricted, because medicine safety checks must read it everywhere.

D-DM-31.title: Words about changing a medicine
D-DM-31.decision: 'Contraindicated', 'stop' and 'hold' when the source says so; never 'reduce' or 'increase'. Everything ends 'review with the prescriber'.

D-DM-32.title: Where 'adult' starts
D-DM-32.decision: 16, and the platform's adolescent band ends there, so 16 to 19-year-olds get the adult rules.

D-DM-33.title: Dolutegravir and glucose
D-DM-33.decision: Follow UCG: lifestyle first for 3 months unless sugars are very high; the 'very high' arm dark until a number is signed (P0-28).

D-DM-34.title: When metformin starts
D-DM-34.decision: When a measure is above target and the person is on no medicine, alongside lifestyle advice (HEARTS-D Fig. 2, the WHO PEN protocol).

D-DM-35.title: Type 1 as must-not-miss on the clerking desk

D-DM-36.title: Pregnancy not recorded
D-DM-36.decision: Nothing that applies only outside pregnancy: the non-pregnant criteria set, the targets and the treatment steps wait for the answer. Acute and suspicion rules still run.

D-DM-37.title: Rules with no sentence to quote
D-DM-37.decision: Sign all six with their reasons.

D-DM-38.title: Glucose 18 or more without ketoacidosis
D-DM-38.decision: WHO PEN: same-day review for everyone at this level (DM-ACT-REFER-GLU-02). Dark until signed.

D-DM-39.title: Blood pressure above 180/110 without organ damage
D-DM-39.decision: UCG 2023: admit above 180/110, as the national text says; the hypertension pack will own it.

D-DM-40.title: Lower limits for older or high-risk people
D-DM-40.decision: Read ADA Standards of Care section 13 (older adults) for the glucose floor and supply a low BP band from the hypertension pack's source; until then the bands carry no 'at target' below the general range for people on insulin or a sulfonylurea aged 65 or over.

D-DM-41.title: The acute escalation floor
D-DM-41.decision: Sign it as the acute lane's contract. Interrupt on: a meter HI or LO; blood ketones 3.0 or more in diabetes or with a high glucose; ketones 1.6–2.9 with vomiting; deep breathing or drowsiness in diabetes, with a high glucose, or with no glucose at all; a glucose of 3.5 with drowsiness, or on insulin, a sulfonylurea, type 1 or unknown medicines; acetone or dehydration on insulin, an SGLT2 inhibitor, type 1, unknown medicines, or in a child with diabetes (unless blood ketones are normal); an SGLT2 inhibitor with vomiting, deep breathing, dehydration or drowsiness; a child with diabetes who is vomiting, in pain or acutely unwell with no glucose; in pregnancy or 6 weeks postpartum (or unanswered) 160/110, or 140/90 with organ damage, drowsiness or headache, or organ damage or drowsiness at any pressure. Same day for the intermediate patterns (ketones 0.6–2.9, vomiting with a high glucose, a low on other medicines, acetone or dehydration in other diabetes until blood ketones are below 0.6, a vomiting or acutely unwell child or insulin-treated adult with diabetes, 140/90 in pregnancy, and an asymptomatic 160/110 with pregnancy unanswered; with headache it interrupts).

D-DM-42.title: Vomiting with a high glucose on insulin; ketoacidosis in pregnancy
D-DM-42.decision: Supply ISPAD 2022 and JBDS sick-day and JBDS-IP (DKA in pregnancy) text; until then keep same-day with 'repeat the strip in 2 hours' and say so.

P0-01.decision: Add numeric age to the context; adult rules from 16 by age, independent of the display band

P0-02.ruling: Numeric age and "could be pregnant" as platform inputs
P0-02.decision: Derive both from demographics (DOB, sex at birth); unknown sex or age ⇒ pregnancy unknown

P0-03.ruling: A list holding only "unknown" satisfies `!= insulin`

P0-04.decision: Adopt the reference evaluator's rule (pack semantics), with truth-table tests

P0-05.ruling: Blocking caveat in diagnosis: drop the criterion or "insufficient"

P0-06.ruling: Metformin with eGFR < 30: amber (live) or red (pack)
P0-06.decision: Keep amber (red is for emergencies; I11)

P0-07.ruling: Live red emergency for glucose < 3.9 in anyone; red danger sign on vomiting with known diabetes
P0-07.decision: Align to N13 and D-DM-24: interrupt below 3.0 or with a sign; level 1 amber outside treated diabetes

P0-08.ruling: Live wording "reduce the insulin or sulfonylurea" vs D-DM-31

P0-09.ruling: Glibenclamide: flag any use (live) or three situations (pack)
P0-09.decision: Pack's three situations plus UCG's glimepiride as named alternative

P0-11.ruling: DKD: staging from a strip; confirmation by 3-month flag or 2 of 3 ACRs
P0-11.decision: Keep strip as fallback category only; confirmation 2 of 3 over 3 months (KDIGO)

P0-12.ruling: Vibration toward loss of protective sensation

P0-13.decision: Replace live WHO set with the pack's (same thresholds, fuller); keep ADA/IDF

P0-14.decision: New tone or `low` with an alert; never "Diabetes range"

P0-15.ruling: DKA "blood ketones < 0.6" against-atom on a must-not-miss
P0-15.decision: Drop (no signature-worthy source that low ketones exclude DKA in context)

P0-16.ruling: Type 1 must-not-miss: reason text; live obese-BMI against-atom
P0-16.decision: Add reason "untreated it becomes ketoacidosis"; remove the obese-BMI against-atom

P0-17.decision: Merge-only for lists; scalars only via explicit `_changes` the CSO signs per field

P0-18.decision: Load nothing using context/pregnancy atoms until EC-3/EC-5; EC-1 gets a three-valued "unknown"

P0-19.ruling: DDX-GLUCOSE-HIGH amend adds steroid hyperglycaemia to every glucose ≥ 11.1

P0-20.ruling: Concept ids (3 wrong; GDM one or two concepts; maculopathy/Ipswich answers; `hx.*` vs `hist.*`; addendum v1.4 or v1.5)
P0-20.decision: Fix the 3; two concepts; extend answers; use `hist.*`; v1.5 (v1.4 is pending)

P0-21.ruling: Test ids: adopt dx catalogue ids or rename

P0-22.decision: Split by `parent` classes; keep the old id as parent

P0-23.ruling: Duplicates (SUG-DM-POSTURAL, DDX-GLUCOSE-VERY-HIGH, FLAG-EX-GLU-KETONE-TEST, REF-DX-GLU-HHS, SUG-* targets)
P0-23.decision: Drop the pack's; keep live ids

P0-24.ruling: Nausea alone triggers vomiting rules until CFC v1.4
P0-24.decision: Accept, documented, or sign CFC v1.4 alongside

P0-25.decision: Literal in `ug_ucg_2023` (it is the text); show both sets side by side

P0-26.decision: WHO 2013 is the default gestational diabetes set; UCG 2023's set is computed and shown alongside (CSO, 2026-10-05)

P0-28.decision: Follow UCG: lifestyle 3 months unless "very high" (no number; dark until a number is signed)
